nodes.label: SEMCOMP26 Boilerplate Template
nodes.rationale: Template repository built for a hackathon (SEMCOMP26): the goal is NOT to learn but to implement only the necessary boilerplate, so agent effort must go to shipping boilerplate fast rather than exploration or teaching.

nodes.label: Load Skill Before Acting Rule
nodes.rationale: Design decision: loading a skill is cheap and skipping it is the #1 mistake; the skill defines HOW to explore, debug, build and verify, so it must come before any action. Process skill first, action second.
